snippet.title: ECLIPSE - trailer
snippet.description:
Eclipse offers a journey through eerie and liminal realms. Your initial playthrough mirrors the character's first experience. Consider this project more as an artistic expression than a video game. This game is an experience.

#indiegame #horrorgaming #piano
